Content 30-39 minutes

Terminal ownership and refusal

  • Invalid values and a pre-aborted valid request reject before Worker creation/send.
  • Abort settles locally once and sends at most one best-effort cancellation.
  • Healthy shared Worker listeners can persist until failure or dispose. Per-request abort listeners retire at settlement.
  • Error/messageerror retire the failed Worker. Dispose rejects pending work, detaches listeners and terminates the owned Worker.

Timeout, crash, cancellation or leak is actual FAIL/BLOCKED. The labelled incomplete starter assertions never excuse an infrastructure failure.

Content 30-39 minutes
